[Verse 1]
[D/G]tucked me in, turned out
[D/F#]the light
[D/E]Kept me safe and sound
[D/F#]at night
[D/G]Little girls depend
[D/F#]on things like
[D/E]that
[D/F#]
[D/G]Brushed my teeth and combed
[D/F#]my hair
[D/E]Had to drive me e-
[D/F#]verywhere
[D/G]You were always there
[D/F#]when I looked
[D/E]back
[D/F#]You had to do
[D/G]it all alone
[D/F#]Make a li-
[D/E]ving, make a home
[D/F#]
[D/G]Must have been as hard
[D/F#]as it could
[D/E]been
[D/F#]And when I could-
[D/G]n't sleep at night
[D/F#]Scared things
[D/E]wouldn't turn out right
[D/F#]
[D/G]You would hold my
[D/F#]hand and sing to me
[D/E]
[A]

[Chorus]
[D]Caterpillar
in the tree
[G]How you wonder
who you'll be
[D]Can't go far, [A/C#]but you
[Bm]can [D/A]always
[E/G#]dream
[Asus4]  [A]
[D]Wish you may, and
wish you might
[G]Don't you worry, hold
on tight I
[D]promise you [A/C#]there
[Bm]will [D/A]come a day
[E/G#]
[Asus4]Butterfly [A]fly away
[D/G]
[D/F#]
[D/E]
[D/F#]

[Verse 2]
[D/G]Butterfly fly away
[D/F#](butterfly fly away)
[D/E]Got your wings, now you
[D/F#]can't stay
[D/G]Take those dreams and make
[D/F#]them all come
[D/E]true
[D/F#]
[D/G]Butterfly fly away
[D/F#](butterfly fly away)
[D/E]You've been waiting for
[D/F#]this day
[D/G]All along you've known
[D/F#]just what to do
[D/E]
[A]

[Outro]
[D/G]Butterfly,
